name: Round Rock Independent School District
districtFact: Round Rock ISD serves students in parts of Round Rock, Austin, and Cedar Park across Williamson and Travis counties. School assignments are based on the student's home address and current attendance boundaries.

about.title: About Round Rock Independent School District
about.content: Round Rock ISD serves communities in Williamson and Travis counties, including parts of Round Rock, Austin, and Cedar Park. Because city names, ZIP codes, and school-district boundaries do not always match, families should confirm campus assignments with the district's official address lookup.

planningTips.title: School Assignment
content: Round Rock ISD assigns schools by home address and current attendance boundaries. Confirm the assigned elementary, middle, and high school with the district before enrollment or a move.

districtFaqs.q: How do I find my child's school in Round Rock ISD?
districtFaqs.a: Round Rock ISD school assignments are based on the student's home address and current attendance boundaries. Use the official district website to confirm the assigned elementary, middle, and high school before enrollment or a move.

relatedDistricts.name: Austin Independent School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Austin ISD serves central Austin immediately south of Round Rock ISD. Compare the official calendars when coordinating schedules across the two districts.

relatedDistricts.name: Leander Independent School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Leander ISD serves communities west of Round Rock ISD, including parts of Cedar Park. District assignment depends on the home address.
